## TRA Timeline

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2014-07-14: Form-of Income Tax Receivable Agreement filed as Ex 10.13 to S-1/A No. 1
- 2014-07-30: IPO closes; TRA executed between El Pollo Loco Holdings and Trimaran Pollo Partners, L.L.C.
- 2014-11-03: Executed TRA filed as Ex 10.1 to Q3 2014 10-Q; initial $40.119M liability recorded

#### Partial termination (FS Equity buyout)

- 2024-05-23: Stock Repurchase Agreement and concurrent "TRA Repurchase Agreement" signed with FS Equity Partners V and FS Affiliates V (unfiled)
- 2024-05-29: FS Equity portion of TRA terminated for $398,895.50; reported via Item 8.01 of 2024-05-23 8-K

#### Full extinguishment

- 2025-03-06: FY2024 10-K confirms zero TRA liability at December 25, 2024; remaining Trimaran-affiliated portion ran off through normal tax-attribute utilization
- 2026-03-12: FY2025 10-K confirms no TRA income recorded in fiscal 2025

## Explanation

El Pollo Loco Holdings entered into its Income Tax Receivable Agreement at the July 30, 2014 IPO close as a single-counterparty contract with Trimaran Pollo Partners, L.L.C. acting as Existing Stockholders Representative for all pre-IPO holders (Trimaran- and Freeman Spogli-affiliated). Unlike a typical Up-C TRA, the contract pays 85% of cash tax savings from pre-IPO net operating loss carryforwards (and related pre-IPO tax attributes) rather than from exchange-driven basis step-ups. Realized payments were far below the prospectus's $39M-$41M estimate, totaling less than $2M cumulatively. On May 29, 2024 the Company executed an unfiled "TRA Repurchase Agreement" concurrent with a Stock Repurchase Agreement, buying out FS Equity's TRA interest for $398,895.50; the remaining Trimaran-affiliated portion decayed to zero through tax-attribute utilization by December 25, 2024, and the FY2024 10-K confirmed full extinguishment. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record and the verification note on the unfiled TRA Repurchase Agreement.
